jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a Senior Product Manager, you will join our Technology team to drive the efficiency of Westwing's supply chain and fulfilment operations across Europe. Operating at the intersection of business and technology, you will partner with senior stakeholders to translate operational strategy into scalable systems across warehouse, order, and delivery management. Having recently completed a major migration of our order and warehouse management systems to modern SaaS platforms, we are now transitioning from initial stabilisation to building the next generation of scalable capabilities on top of that foundation. In this high-impact role, you will directly drive operational excellence and cost efficiency by shaping the systems that power our end-to-end processes, from initial sourcing to final customer delivery. This position is permanent and based in Munich.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with stakeholders across Sourcing, Logistics, Warehouse, and Operations to own the roadmap for our Supply Chain and Fulfilment systems, spanning both SaaS platforms and in-house tools
  • Own and drive measurable business outcomes aligned with company OKRs and operational performance targets, translating operational needs into clear functional specifications and defining KPIs for data-led optimisation
  • Coordinate the implementation of new and existing capabilities with our SaaS vendors and integration partners, driving delivery through to rollout
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for in-house operational tools, from prioritisation and delivery to continuous improvement, working closely with engineering, data, and design teams to ensure high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery
  • Drive product discovery to identify automation and optimisation opportunities, leveraging AI and emerging technologies to innovate across the supply chain
  • Make build-versus-buy decisions based on speed, scalability, and long-term impact, helping shape our evolving strategy across SaaS and in-house tooling as AI lowers the cost of custom software


YOU COME WITH

  • 5+ years of product management experience within e-commerce, retail, or logistics, with a solid understanding of fulfilment and warehouse operations and systems such as OMS, WMS, or ERP
  • Proven track record of implementing, configuring, and integrating SaaS solutions, with a strong comfort level blending product ownership with hands-on vendor and implementation coordination
  • Extensive experience in project management, business analysis, Agile methodologies, and leading cross-functional teams to drive continuous process improvements
  • Comfort with Excel and SQL, combined with practical experience using AI tools to accelerate research, documentation, and prototyping
  • Strong analytical mindset with a passion for using data to distinguish between what technically works and what truly scales
  • Fluency in English paired with excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders across all functional and management levels
  • High resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities


WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.
At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

• A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
• An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
• A flexible hybrid setup with 3 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
• Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas
• 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
• A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect
• Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), 10% Family & Friends discount, plus special-occasion vouchers
• Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
• Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet
• Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl
• One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower
• Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest


ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

Technology

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d) - FinTech for Social Care
jobs.description:
You will build payment infrastructure for a sector that is running out of capacity and we are all depending on.

By 2050, 38 million people across the EU will need long-term care, and the sector already lacks the workforce to deliver it. Care organisations need technology that gives professionals more time for people. We build the payment infrastructure that makes this possible.

Your job: build and ship the products for it.

Parto is the all-in-one payments platform for social care organisations. We digitise cash, expense, and payment processes in youth services, disability support, and elderly care - making them simple, secure, and fully digital.

With Parto Visa cards and our software platform, care professionals can efficiently manage client funds, team budgets, and everyday operational expenses. We reduce administrative work, eliminate disconnected processes, and create lasting relief for care teams, administration, and finance departments.

Parto is backed by Motive Ventures New York/Berlin, Heal Capital Berlin and Shapers Lisbon, plus experienced business angels.

You will join an ambitious team whose experience includes Trade Republic, JPMorgan Chase, CHECK24 Bank, Strategy&, and Ruuky. Together, we are building a new category of financial software for one of society's most important sectors.

Tasks

As Product Manager at Parto, you will play a defining role in the future of our platform.

You will be our second product manager, working directly with our founder and CPO, alongside a product designer and an engineering team of 11. Small team, large surface area: your decisions ship.

You will build digital financial products for the social care sector and help modernise an industry that urgently needs better technology. Your work will solve real problems and shape how thousands of professionals manage money every day.

This is not a role in which requirements are handed to you. You will own initiatives from the first customer insight through discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You will work AI-native from day one. Every PM at Parto uses AI agents daily for discovery, analysis, specs, and delivery. We expect you to push what a single PM can own.

Together with engineering and product design, you will ensure that we solve the right problems and turn them into products that create measurable value.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Develop a deeper understanding of our users, their workflows, and their constraints than anyone else in the company.
  • Translate customer conversations, user feedback, product data, regulatory requirements, and company goals into clear product decisions.
  • Own and prioritise your roadmap based on outcomes and strategic leverage, and make difficult scope decisions while keeping your team moving at high speed.
  • Lead discovery and turn ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, requirements, and measures of success.
  • Work closely with engineering and product design from the earliest idea through launch, adoption, and iteration.
  • Own integrations with external partners and third-party systems, including the operational details required to make them successful.
  • Contribute to Parto's long-term product strategy and help define the category we intend to lead.

What success looks like in your first six months

Months 1-2: Understand and take ownership

You develop a detailed understanding of our users, product, business model, and technology. You establish strong relationships with customers and your engineering counterparts, challenge existing assumptions, and take ownership of your first product area.

Months 3-4: Ship and learn

You lead your first meaningful initiative from problem definition to launch. You establish clear success metrics, remove blockers quickly, and build a direct feedback loop between customers and the product team.

Months 5-6: Raise the bar

You independently drive your roadmap, make difficult prioritisation decisions, and demonstrate measurable impact. Your understanding of customers begins to shape Parto's broader product strategy.

We work with real startup intensity. The pace is high, the problems are unsolved, and the learning curve is steep. If you are looking for a quiet position with fixed instructions and a rigid scope, you will not be happy at Parto.

If you want to build a product category from the ground up, take real responsibility, and become better at your craft faster than almost anywhere else, we would love to meet you.

What working at Parto means

  • You make consequential decisions yourself and take responsibility for the results.
  • Feedback is direct, frequent, and expected in both directions.
  • You create clarity instead of waiting for perfect instructions.
  • You move quickly without compromising on the quality of important decisions.
  • You adapt when new evidence challenges the current plan.
  • The team supports you and trusts you to run your own scope.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • At least three years of product management experience, ideally in FinTech, payments, or another complex B2B SaaS environment.
  • A strong track record of owning products or major initiatives end-to-end and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  • The ability to turn complex and sometimes conflicting requirements into clear product decisions and priorities.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence using qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions.
  • High agency and relentless ownership. You identify what matters, create a path forward, and stay with the problem until it is solved.
  • A hands-on mindset and the ability to move confidently between product strategy and operational detail.
  • Experience working closely with engineers and product designers in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment.
  • The ability to build trust with customers and manage internal and external stakeholders at different levels.
  • Technical fluency to discuss APIs, system integrations, data flows, dependencies, and technical trade-offs with engineers.
  • Native German level and professional fluency in English, our company language.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in payments, banking, expense management, or card products.
  • Familiarity with accounting processes and financial reconciliation.
  • Experience with ERP integrations or mission-critical B2B software.
  • Experience building products in regulated environments.
  • Understanding of social care, healthcare, or other operationally complex service industries.

We do not expect you to match every item. We care more about your judgement, trajectory, and evidence of exceptional ownership than a perfectly linear CV.

Benefits

  • Build something that matters: Create a new category of software for a sector that is both economically important and socially essential.
  • Real ownership and impact: Your decisions will directly influence how hundreds of organisations and thousands of professionals work.
  • Accelerated personal growth: Receive direct feedback, meaningful responsibility, and opportunities to grow faster than in a narrowly defined role.
  • Competitive compensation and ownership: Receive a fair salary plus virtual company shares through our VSOP programme.
  • A greenfield environment: Shape the product, operating model, and culture while the most important decisions are still ahead of us.
  • Hamburg headquarters: We build together in person, from the heart of Hamburg. Hybrid is possible, remote is not.
  • Hardware of your choice: Choose the MacBook, setup, and equipment that help you do your best work.
  • 30+ days of annual leave: Time for proper rest and a life outside work.
  • Workations: Work temporarily from another location when it fits the team and your responsibilities.
  • Tax-free benefits: Receive additional funds for mobility, sports, and other personal benefits.
  • European team offsites: Regular opportunities to work, travel, and spend time together as a team.

Does this sound like you? We would love to meet you.

Apply with your profile and two sentences answering the following question:

What was the last product or major initiative you truly owned - and what would you do differently if you built it again today?

No cover letter required.

We have built a cloud object storage solution comparable to AWS S3, purpose-built and optimised for AI and compute workloads. Our commercial hyper-growth speaks for itself, powered by our channel-first go-to-market strategy.

We are now expanding beyond storage: we are building a high-performance compute platform, offering an end-to-end solution from GPU infrastructure to full GPU platform software stack. In doing so, we are redefining the cloud ecosystem by bridging the gap between decentralised infrastructure (DePIN), mainstream B2B cloud use cases, and AI applications.

 

Find out more about us here.

 

Please note that we can only consider candidates who have a valid, unrestricted work permit for the EU.


Your Impact

You will own the product and go-to-market strategy for our GPU and AI services, working directly with the founders to define what we build, how we price and package it, and which customer segments and use cases we go after first. Success in 12 months means a validated commercial model with thousands of AI B2B customers and a product roadmap with huge customer pull behind it.

jobs.title: (Lead/Senior) Technical Product Manager - Platform Engineering (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

As (Lead/Senior) Technical Product Manager for Platform Engineering, you will shape the internal platform products that help our builders ship better software faster, more reliably, and with less friction.

You will partner with engineering across Developer Platform & Security to turn complex platform capabilities into products that developers and AI agents love to use. Your work will cover internal developer experience, cloud and infrastructure workflows, CI/CD, observability, security guardrails, Backstage, AI coding tools and agentic workflows.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage people, but you will influence technical direction, product strategy, and adoption across engineering.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic Product Leadership: Own and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Platform Engineering products, aligned with company priorities and engineering needs.

  • Platform-As-Product: Treat internal capabilities like real products, using discovery, user research, feedback loops, and adoption data to solve actual builder problems.

  • Stakeholder Management: Align engineers, product managers, engineering leads, security, SRE, and senior leadership around a clear platform direction.

  • Impact Ownership: Define and track success metrics such as platform adoption, Change Lead Time, MTTD/MTTR, etc.This includes translating complex technical platform initiatives and metrics into clear business impact and ROI for non-technical, (C-level) stakeholders.

  • Internal Product Evangelism: Communicate complex technical products in a clear, compelling way so teams understand, trust, and adopt them.

  • Agentic Engineering Enablement: Help shape the tools, context layers, and guardrails that allow humans and AI agents to build and release software safely.

  • Prioritisation & Trade-Offs: Balance speed, reliability, security, simplicity, and long-term maintainability in a fast-moving scale-up environment.

Technologies your teams will work with include:

  • Google Cloud Platform, Vercel

  • Terraform / Terramate

  • GitHub Actions

  • Backstage

  • Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Incident.io

  • Cursor, MCP, and agentic engineering workflows

  • TypeScript, Python and GoLang


Dein Profil

You have:

  • Several years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, or a similar role for technical products.
  • A strong platform-as-product mindset, ideally with experience building internal tools, developer platforms, infrastructure products, or technical B2B products.
  • Enough technical depth to reason about cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, security, and software delivery trade-offs with engineers.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into narratives that different audiences can understand.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • A pragmatic, outcome-oriented way of working, focused on solving real problems fast.
  • Excellent English communication skills; German is a plus.
Bonus points for:
  • Experience with platform engineering, SRE, cloud infrastructure, security, developer experience, or internal developer portals.
  • Hands-on technical background, coding experience.
  • Experience in a scale-up environment with roughly 100 to 1000 employees.
  • Interest in climate tech and renewable energy.


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

Mit über 80 Patenten und mehr als 10 GW installierten Trackern in über 30 Ländern steigern wir weltweit Energieerträge, erhöhen die langfristige Zuverlässigkeit und treiben die Energiewende voran.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Fuel and energy are among the largest controllable costs any fleet carries, yet most operators still make those decisions with partial data and disconnected tools. Samsara already sees how these fleets actually run and that data is the raw material for a new generation of cost-optimization products.

As a Senior Product Manager on this team, you'll own a product area end to end and turn that operational data into products the world's largest fleets rely on to cut fuel spend, run more efficiently, and navigate the shift to electric. Our portfolio spans fuel cost optimization (fuel cards, bulk fuel, partner programs), driver and vehicle efficiency, EVs and energy transition, as well as operational cost intelligence.

The exact area you own will be shaped by your strengths and where the team needs you most at the time of joining. In every case, you'll work at the intersection of operational data, financial outcomes, and fleet performance, partnering closely with engineering, design, data science, business development, and go-to-market to ship products that turn Samsara's telematics platform into a cost-optimization and energy-management engine for the world's largest fleets.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want your work to move the physical economy: The products you ship will help real fleets spend less on fuel, waste less energy, and keep goods and people moving.
  • You want real ownership: You'll own a product area's vision, strategy, and roadmap. If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages your personal development and rewards ownership.
  • You're drawn to hard, open-ended problems: Much of this space has no playbook yet, especially as we ship AI-powered products into workflows that have never had them.
  • You appreciate candid feedback and an experimental mindset: Samsara employees challenge the status quo and recognize failure as part of the learning process. We encourage each other to be honest and hold ourselves to high standards.

In this role, you will: 

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a key product area, which may include fuel cost optimization, fleet efficiency, energy management, or operational cost intelligence.
  • Translate Samsara's operational data (telematics, fuel consumption, idling, routing, vehicle health) into products that help customers reduce costs and improve fleet performance.
  • Run deep discovery with the people who live these problems: fleet owners, fuel managers, operations leaders, and finance teams.
  • Prototype and design MVPs yourself - clickable flows, working demos, rough cuts, often AI-assisted - to pressure-test ideas with customers before committing engineering time.
  • Ship end-to-end experiences with design, engineering, and data science - from backend pipelines and partner integrations to the dashboards and mobile surfaces customers use every day.
  • Define success metrics, build business cases for new initiatives, and drive a continuous cycle of experimentation and iteration grounded in data and customer feedback.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping products used by real customers at scale.
  • You can point to something you designed, prototyped or built yourself and a cross-functional launch you drove end to end; you have both the maker and the operator in you.

Senior Product Manager - B2B SaaS / Digital Health (alle Identitäten)
jobs.description:
Das erwartet Dich

Bei Caspar Health entwickelst Du die zentrale digitale Arbeitsumgebung für Therapeut*innen und Klinikteams weiter. Dein Auftrag ist klar. Klinische Prozesse sollen einfacher, schneller und sicherer werden, damit Fachkräfte mehr Zeit für die Behandlung ihrer Patient*innen haben.

Unser HCP-Produkt verbindet Patientenbetreuung, Therapieplanung und klinische Abläufe. Es wird bereits von Therapeut*innen und Klinikteams genutzt und soll zu ihrer zentralen Arbeitsumgebung werden. Du identifizierst die größten Engpässe in diesen Abläufen und verbesserst sie so, dass Zeitaufwand sinkt, die Nutzung steigt und die Versorgungsqualität erhalten oder verbessert wird.

Als Senior Product Manager verantwortest Du Produktstrategie, Discovery, Priorisierung und messbare Outcomes für diesen Bereich. Du berichtest direkt an den CPO und führst ein cross-funktionales Squad fachlich durch klare Ziele und Entscheidungen. Wir suchen keinen Backlog-Verwalter oder Ticket-Schubser. Du verantwortest Probleme und Outcomes. Roadmap, Backlog und Delivery sind für Dich Mittel, um messbare Verbesserungen zu erreichen.

Deine Herausforderungen

  • End-to-End Produktverantwortung: Als Product Manager für das HCP-Produkt entwickelst du Vision, Strategie und Roadmap; Dabei priorisierst du zwischen Kundennutzen, Versorgungsqualität, technischer Machbarkeit und wirtschaftlichem Beitrag und machst Zielkonflikte früh sichtbar
  • AI-native Produktentwicklung: AI (Skills, Agents) setzt du gezielt dort ein, wo Research, Datenanalyse, Prototyping oder Delivery nachweisbar beschleunigt werden; Entscheidend sind dabei die Qualität der Entscheidungen und die Geschwindigkeit des Lernens – nicht das verwendete Werkzeug
  • Nutzer- und Domänennähe: Regelmäßig arbeitest du mit Therapeut*innen unserer Caspar Clinic sowie externer Kliniken zusammen; Ein- bis zweimal pro Quartal beobachtest du Abläufe vor Ort und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse gemeinsam mit Produktdaten in priorisierte Probleme und überprüfbare Hypothesen
  • Hands-on AI-Prototyping & Codebase: Eigenständig entwickelst du Prototypen, um kritische Annahmen früh zu testen. Technische Konzepte verstehst du sicher, arbeitest mit Entwickler*innen auf Augenhöhe und bringst bei passenden Aufgaben auch selbst Änderungen live
  • Product Craft & Squad-Führung: Dem Squad gibst du ein klares Problem, ein messbares Ziel und den nötigen Kontext; Schwierige Entscheidungen moderierst du souverän, priorisierst konsequent und sorgst dafür, dass das Team Wirkung statt Output optimiert
  • Messbarer Impact: Noch vor der Umsetzung definierst du, woran Erfolg erkennbar ist; Dabei misst du unter anderem Zeitaufwand, erfolgreiche Nutzung zentraler Abläufe, Nutzerzufriedenheit und wirtschaftlichen Beitrag – Qualität und Sicherheit der Versorgung bleiben dabei feste Leitplanken

Dein Profil

  • Produkt-Erfolgsbilanz: Du hast ein komplexes B2B- oder SaaS-Produkt end-to-end verantwortet und kannst deinen Beitrag anhand konkreter Ergebnisse belegen; Neue Produkte oder größere Produktbereiche hast du aufgebaut, weiterentwickelt oder neu ausgerichtet
  • AI-native Builder-Skills: AI und LLMs nutzt du praktisch für Research, Analyse oder Prototyping und kannst zeigen, wie du damit Lern- oder Delivery-Zyklen verkürzt hast; Mit technischen Entwicklungsabläufen bist du vertraut; Erfahrung mit GitHub und Pull Requests ist von Vorteil
  • Kommunikations- & Moderationsstärke: Komplexe Sachverhalte vermittelst du Fachpersonal und Tech-Teams klar und adressatengerecht; Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab
  • Autonomie & High-Performance: Themen treibst du eigenständig voran, triffst Entscheidungen in deinem Verantwortungsbereich und machst Risiken früh sichtbar; Unterstützung holst du dir rechtzeitig, bevor Abhängigkeiten oder ungeklärte Entscheidungen den Fortschritt gefährden
  • Pragmatische Evidenz- & Datennähe: Qualitative Discovery verbindest du mit Produkt- und Geschäftsdaten; Du formulierst überprüfbare Hypothesen, kennst die Grenzen deiner Evidenz und passt Vorhaben anhand neuer Erkenntnisse an – oder stoppst sie konsequent

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Procurement & Portfolio Management (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

As Product Manager Procurement & Portfolio Management, you take on one of the most strategically defining product roles within our energy retail business: you design how 1KOMMA5° procures, hedges, and optimizes electricity for an increasingly flexible customer portfolio. You sit at the intersection of energy markets, energy procurement, our flexibility assets, and our customer-facing tariff strategy - and you turn this into a measurable commercial advantage.

  • Own our Procurement Strategy: Define how and where 1KOMMA5° procures energy for our customer portfolio - across day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets. Develop a clear market split logic, and continuously refine it based on portfolio characteristics, customer mix, and market conditions.

  • Design Portfolio Hedging & Risk Management: Build hedging and risk management strategies tailored to different customer portfolios (dynamic vs fixed tariffs or flexibility/ancillary services). Define when and how we lock in volumes, what we leave open, and how we balance commercial upside against risk exposure.

  • Shape Our Flexibility Procurement Model: Design how we procure and steer our flexibility portfolio. Defining models such as flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price-based offers, and the trade-offs between them. Develop the commercial logic and the operational requirements for each model.

  • Run Quantitative Portfolio Analysis: Independently run analyses on procurement performance, hedging effectiveness, and portfolio economics. Build the analytical foundation that supports strategic decisions, identifies optimization opportunities, and quantifies the impact of changes to our procurement and steering setup.

  • Monitor Performance and Drive Continuous Improvement: Define KPIs across procurement cost, hedge effectiveness, portfolio risk, and flexibility margin. Use data to continuously sharpen our market positioning and commercial performance.


Dein Profil

General:

  • 4+ years of experience in (international) energy procurement, portfolio management, or energy trading, ideally in a utility, energy retailer, trading desk, or aggregator environment

  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience running portfolio analyses, hedge calculations, and market scenarios (Python, SQL, or comparable tools are a strong plus)

  • Proven ability to translate market and commercial logic into structured processes and product requirements

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving market environment

  • Excellent written and spoken English and German

Market & Domain Expertise:

  • Deep understanding of European power markets - day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets - and the mechanisms that drive prices

  • Solid working knowledge of hedging instruments (futures, options, OTC), balancing markets, and BRP settlement

  • Familiarity with flexibility products and procurement models (flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price offers) and their commercial trade-offs

  • Awareness of regulatory frameworks shaping energy retail (Marktkommunikationsprozesse, balancing regimes, market design developments)

  • Experience working with external procurement partners, ETRM systems, or trading platforms is a strong plus


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups

  • You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens

  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

You own the product and the priorities behind it. The hard part of that job here is structural: our go-to-market runs vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt.

You sit between Sales and Engineering and translate in both directions. Towards Sales: which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim. Towards Engineering: which requirement is ready to be built, what it needs to be complete, and what we deliberately leave out.

This is an early-stage role and we expect you to shape it rather than inherit it. We are extending the core of the application right now, which means your first decisions land while the product is still taking form. At the beginning, a meaningful part of your work will be spent on customer projects, close to the people whose decisions we model. That is where you see which patterns are worth turning into product.

We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, wild workload, and a go to market with the product and its tech that is a day to day focus and iteration process.

What you'll own

  • The product roadmap and the reasoning behind it: what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.
  • The boundary between standard product, configuration, and manual work for one customer.
  • Requirements that engineering can build from: scope, acceptance criteria, and a clear statement of what is out.
  • What we can credibly promise a customer, including where the product's limits currently are.
  • Proofs of Value that you run yourself, and responsibility for individual accounts.
  • Prototypes you build to test features with customers before we commit engineering time.
  • How product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering.

Your number: how much of what is project work today is standard product a year from now, and the time from a recognised customer problem to a usable capability.

This role is not for you if your strength is backlog, process and ceremonies, if you need research and design capacity before you can decide, if a complex industrial domain is an obstacle rather than the interesting part, if you don't like data or if you need more than three days before your first customer conversation.

Requirements

  • A technical and analytical foundation, engineering, data analytics, data science, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling from a technical degree, technical consulting, or technical product management. You will not write production code, but you need to recognise when a requirement creates technical debt, or is built in a way that cannot be reused at the next customer.
  • 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. More important than the title: you have owned a product area end to end before, not only a backlog.
  • Experience deciding under incomplete information, and the ability to explain your trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
  • You can sit with a plant manager or a controller, understand how they decide today, and leave the room knowing what the product has to do about it.
  • Good to have, not a cut off: optimization experience, deeper knowledge in manufacturing, supply chain or S&OP, enterprise B2B sales cycles involving operations, IT and controlling, or early-stage startup experience.
  • German C1 or higher, fluent in English.
  • NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.

Benefits

  • Impact. You work with substance and lead what the product becomes.
  • Ownership. You define how product works here: what we build, what we decline, and where the boundary between product and project sits. No approval loops.
  • The people next to you. You work directly with the researchers and modellers, have access to tech deliveries and execute and build on eye level with the founders.
  • Exposure. You present your own roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, you sit in the core strategy conversations, and you stand in front of the people whose decisions we model.
  • Feedback speed. You will know directly what you are up to, we speak out loud, we adjust, we grow. Together.
  • High stakes. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.

Process: Intro call with Dana or Erik, second call with one from the team, a 60 to 90-minute live case exercise on a real customer requirement, then team conversations in person. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.

"Hustle the day, analyse at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Become a part of our mission and learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value. In your role you will:

  • Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.

  • Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products: Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives.

  • Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.

  • Analyze & Improve Marktkommunikation Processes: Dive into our market communication workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive initiatives that make our energy retail engine faster and more reliable.

  • Monitor Performance & Iterate: Leverage customer feedback, competitive analysis, and market trends. Monitor KPIs to help optimize product adoption and overall customer satisfaction.

  • Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.


Dein Profil

  • You are enrolled at a university for at least two more semesters and can support us 15-20 hours per week during the semester, with up to 40 hours per week during semester breaks

  • You are studying Business, Economics, Engineering, Energy Management, or a comparable course of studies

  • You have a keen interest in the energy market, energy tariffs, and the energy transition, with a strong motivation to drive impactful change

  • You have experience with and enjoy working in Google Sheets/Excel: SQL or Python skills are a plus

  • You are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple projects at the same time

  • You are a problem solver, able to adapt to changing environments and stakeholder needs

  • Previous experience in the energy sector, product management, or consulting is a plus, but we're happy to get you up to speed - motivation counts!

  • Excellent language skills in English and German (both written and spoken)


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups

  • You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

  • Flexible working hours that fit around your university schedule

  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, GenAI Enablement Squad, Foundations Alliance
Werkstudent:in Mitarbeiter Vertragswesen (all genders)
jobs.description:
In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren.

Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt.

Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort.

Über die Rolle

Als Werkstudent:.in im Vertragskundenservice unterstützt du unsere Geschäftskunden bei allen Fragen rund um ihre Verträge, Bestellungen, Rechnungen und Kündigungen. Du bist eine zentrale Anlaufstelle für ihre Anliegen und sorgst dafür, dass Anfragen freundlich, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert bearbeitet werden.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen internen Teams wie Customer Success und Logistik zusammen, klärst offene Fragen und leitest Anliegen gezielt an die richtigen Ansprechpartner weiter. So trägst du dazu bei, unseren Kunden eine reibungslose Customer Experience zu bieten und unsere internen Abläufe zuverlässig zu unterstützen.

Das erwartet dich

  • Kundenbetreuung: Betreuung von Geschäftskunden bei Fragen rund um Verträge, Bestellungen, Rechnungen und Kündigungen – telefonisch und schriftlich.
  • Anfragenbearbeitung: Entgegennahme, Prüfung und eigenständige Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen sowie Einleitung notwendiger nächster Schritte.
  • Vertragsmanagement: Bearbeitung vertragsbezogener Vorgänge sowie zuverlässige und sorgfältige Umsetzung von Anfragen und Änderungen.
  • Dokumentation: Strukturierte Dokumentation von Kundenanfragen, Bearbeitungsständen und relevanten Informationen in den entsprechenden Systemen.
  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Customer Success, Logistik und weiteren Teams sowie proaktive Weiterleitung von Anfragen an die richtigen Ansprechpartner.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung im Kundenservice: Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrung in der telefonischen oder schriftlichen Kundenbetreuung mit, idealerweise im kaufmännischen Kundenservice oder in einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.
  • Kundenorientierung: Du arbeitest empathisch und serviceorientiert und hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Kunden.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen kommunizierst du freundlich, ruhig und professionell.
  • Digitale Affinität: Du arbeitest sicher mit gängigen Office-Anwendungen, findest dich schnell in neue Tools und Systeme ein und hast Freude daran, digital zu arbeiten.
  • Struktur & Priorisierung: Du kannst mehrere Anfragen parallel bearbeiten, Informationen strukturiert erfassen und Aufgaben sinnvoll priorisieren.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau.

Warum diese Stelle?

  • Einarbeitung & Entwicklung: Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie individuelle Coachings, die auf persönliche Stärken abgestimmt sind und die fachliche sowie persönliche Weiterentwicklung unterstützen.
  • B2B-Kundenkontakt: Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftskund:innen in einem professionellen und wertschätzenden Umfeld.
  • Teamkultur: Arbeit in einem unterstützenden Team, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Austausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung im Mittelpunkt stehen – nicht reine Ticketbearbeitung.
  • Arbeitszeiten: Geregelte Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag (zwischen 09:00 und 18:00 Uhr), keine Wochenend- oder Feiertagsarbeit.

Warum Shiftmove?

  • Produkte mit echtem Impact bauen: Wir lösen komplexe, alltägliche Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa - und ersetzen manuelle, fragmentierte Flottenprozesse durch datengetriebene, intelligente Lösungen, auf die sich unsere Kund:innen verlassen.
  • Sinnvoll skalieren: Wir sind ein profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit starken Fundamenten und einer klaren Vision (1 Mio. Fahrzeuge auf unserer Plattform bis 2027) – eine seltene Kombination aus Stabilität, Ownership und Geschwindigkeit.
  • International & kollaborativ arbeiten: Mit über 30 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sind Zusammenarbeit und gemeinsame Verantwortung fest in unserer Arbeitsweise verankert.
  • Wachsen mit Autonomie und Vertrauen: Wir investieren gezielt in Produkt, Daten und Menschen – und geben dir den Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen, andere herauszufordern und aktiv mitzugestalten, wie wir skalieren.

Benefits

  • Urlaub: 30 Tage
  • Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr weltweit remote arbeiten
  • Hundefreundliches Office: Vierbeinige Kolleg:innen sind bei uns willkommen 🐶
  • Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung
  • Hauptbenefits: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony-Abo, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum BVG-Ticket
  • Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day + Zugang zu nilo.health
  • Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen 1× pro Woche, zweiwöchentliches Company Breakfast sowie rund um die Uhr verfügbare Getränke & Snacks 🍕

Administrative Infos

  • Vertragsart: Wekstudent:in
  • Standort: Berlin oder Remote (in Deutschland)
  • Arbeitsmodell: Wenn in Berlin, dann hybrid mit 2 Tagen pro Woche im Büro im Herzen von Friedrichshain (Warschauer Straße 57)

We mean it!

Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser.

Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Uns interessieren Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge ins Rollen bringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Du bist nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung.

(Senior) QA Engineer - AI-Driven Testing (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

As part of one or two cross-functional mobile product teams, you will own the quality of our Flutter apps, and change how we approach testing.
AI-driven QA is the differentiator in this role. Our QA team already uses AI for test generation, but we want to go much further. You will help invent this from scratch: autonomous exploration, smarter test orchestration, self-directed QA workflows, and QA systems that detect product risks before they reach users.
This is not a "write test cases and file tickets" role. You co-own product quality end-to-end, tell engineering teams where the gaps are, and build the systems and practices that let us ship with confidence. Faster, not slower.
You think about quality as something you design into the product and process, not a checklist you run before release.

Our Stack

  • Flutter & TypeScript
  • Appium, BrowserStack
  • Testmo for test case management
  • GCP, GitHub Actions, Datadog
  • AI-assisted development with Cursor and agentic coding workflows
  • Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro
Key Responsibilities
  • Own quality across our mobile products end-to-end: test strategy, execution, and production monitoring
  • Work embedded in one or two cross-functional product teams and shape quality practices with engineers, product, and design
  • Find the gaps in our current testing approach and close them
  • Grow and maintain our automated test suite (Appium / BrowserStack). Keep it fast, stable, trusted, and focused on critical user journeys
  • Advise engineers on testing strategy and testability early, at the design stage, not after the build
  • Push AI-driven QA beyond test generation: bring in autonomous exploratory testing, intelligent orchestration, and self-directed testing workflows
  • Build QA feedback loops that are tightly integrated with development. Quality should be a real-time signal, not a gate at the end
  • Keep test infrastructure healthy: less flakiness, faster runs, results the whole team can act on
  • Use AI tools wherever they make you and the team more effective, and figure out where autonomous QA can reduce repetitive manual work while preserving human judgment where it matters


Dein Profil

  • 5+ years of QA experience across manual testing, automation, and test strategy.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile test automation (Appium or comparable) and cloud device farms (BrowserStack or similar)
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (we use GitHub Actions) and using quality signals to support rapid, reliable releases
  • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, client-server interactions, and API integrations, with a feel for common mobile failure patterns
  • You understand the SDLC and can design test strategies around how complex products fail
  • Practical experience leveraging AI in QA workflows such as exploratory testing, test case design, defect analysis, and autonomous testing agents. Or you have a clear vision for it and can show you've been building in that direction
  • You care about user journeys and real-world scenarios, not just code coverage numbers
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You figure out the path forward when there's no playbook
  • Clear communicator in written and spoken English
Bonus points for:
  • German language skills
  • Experience with energy systems, IoT, or climate tech
  • Startup or scale-up experience
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs or AI agents in a QA or DevEx context


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

jobs.title: Senior Technical SEO Manager (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Technical SEO Manager to join our Marketing team in the Madrid Office. This position ensures the technical SEO integrity of our multilingual community commerce platform across nine international markets - like mydealz.de, hotukdeals, and more. It combines classic Technical SEO with solid AI, data, and automation skills to ensure that indexing, category, and reporting workflows are scalable and not manual.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct technical audits, crawl/log-file analyses, and manage indexation (noindex, canonicals, robots.txt) to resolve issues on a platform with large URL volumes.
  • Strategically advance our Entity Optimization and Semantic Search capabilities through structured data (Schema.org) and internal linking to build a machine-readable Knowledge Graph.
  • Drive the technical readiness of the platform for generative search engines (GEO) and AI-powered answers (AIO), including managing AI crawlers.
  • Build and automate internal tools, apps, and monitoring workflows using an AI-first approach with tools like Claude, Lovable, v0, Cursor, and n8n.
  • Establish workflows to measure and analyze our visibility within AI answers and translate SEO goals into actionable technical requirements for Product & Tech teams.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with deep experience in technical SEO for large-scale websites, who has a proven ability to leverage AI and automation to create scalable systems.

  • Proven experience working with Screaming Frog, GSC, Ahrefs/SISTRIX/SEMrush; HTML/CSS, JS rendering, Schema.org;
  • Deep understanding of entity-based search and Knowledge Graphs; AI-first building with LLMs (Claude, Lovable, etc.).
  • Nice to have: Dashboarding, database experience, programmatic SEO, and experience building agent/tooling infrastructures (n8n).
  • Experience isolating platform-wide patterns and algorithmic anomalies across all markets, distinguishing business impact from digital noise.
  • Systematically dissects root causes when algorithms change, finding creative workarounds where standard tools reach their limits.
  • Experience translating highly complex technical SEO dependencies into clear business value for Product Owners and developers.
  • Independently identifies and prioritizes high-impact actions and documents workflows to ensure team resilience.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and spoken in English; any other language is a plus

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-RB1

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

jobs.description:
Es freut uns, dass du da bist!



Du möchtest Infrastruktur nicht nur betreiben, sondern strategisch weiterdenken, technische Standards setzen und moderne Hybrid- und Cloud-Architekturen aktiv gestalten? Als zentrale technische Instanz im Infrastrukturteam übernimmst Du Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten IT-Infrastruktur – von On-Premises über Azure bis Modern Workplace. Dabei gibst Du fachliche Orientierung, bringst Deine Engineering-Expertise hands-on in anspruchsvolle Projekte ein und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Plattformen stabil, sicher, skalierbar und zukunftsfähig bleiben.

Wir, die proLogistik Group, sind Marktführer für Systemlösungen in der Supply Chain. Mit rund 800 erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir innovative Soft- und Hardware-Lösungen für die Logistik. Mit Leidenschaft arbeiten wir in einem starken Miteinander und einer Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe neue Ideen aus. Um dein Potenzial bestmöglich zu fördern, legen wir großen Wert auf selbstbestimmtes Arbeiten und bieten dir vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, weil wir deinen täglichen Einsatz und Beitrag zu unserem Erfolg schätzen.
 
Wachse mit uns als
Senior Infrastructure Architect  / Technical Lead (m/w/d) 


Deine Aufgaben bei uns

  • Du übernimmst als zentrale technische Instanz im Infrastrukturteam Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Infrastrukturarchitektur – von On-Premises über Hybrid bis Cloud – und gibst fachliche Orientierung, ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung zu tragen.
  • Du definierst technische Standards für zentrale Infrastrukturthemen wie Server, Virtualisierung, Azure, Client Management, Storage und Backup und erstellst fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Teamlead, IT-Leitung und Management.
  • Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für das Infrastrukturteam und den Teamlead Infrastructure, gibst fachliche Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und unterstützt durch Coaching, Mentoring sowie aktiven Wissenstransfer.
  • Du arbeitest hands-on an anspruchsvollen Infrastrukturprojekten, Migrationen und Modernisierungsvorhaben mit, führst Architektur- und Design-Reviews durch und unterstützt bei Root-Cause-Analysen, Problem Management und technischen Eskalationen.
  • Du verantwortest die technische Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-Azure- und Hybrid-Architekturen, unterstützt bei Modern-Workplace-Themen wie Intune, Endpoint Management, Identity Management und Tenant-Harmonisierung und bewertest neue Cloud-Technologien hinsichtlich Eignung, Wirtschaftlichkeit und strategischem Nutzen.
  • Du sorgst für stabile, skalierbare und sichere Infrastrukturplattformen, entwickelst Server-, Virtualisierungs- und Rechenzentrumsarchitekturen weiter und integrierst Security-by-Design sowie Anforderungen aus ISO 27001 und NIS2 gemeinsam mit Security in unsere Infrastrukturprojekte.
  • Du treibst Standardisierung, Automatisierung und ITIL-orientierte Betriebsmodelle voran, entwickelst technische Roadmaps, Runbooks und Dokumentationen weiter und arbeitest eng mit Security, Netzwerk, Rechenzentrum, Client Management, Entwicklung sowie externen Dienstleistern zusammen.


Das bringst du mit

Muss-Anforderungen

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior System Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer oder Infrastructure Architect mit und hast bereits komplexe Infrastrukturumgebungen technisch begleitet oder weiterentwickelt.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Entra ID und Windows Server und kannst diese sicher in modernen Infrastrukturarchitekturen einsetzen.
  • Du hast gute Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungsplattformen wie z. B. VMware sowie mit Enterprise-Netzwerken und verstehst deren Zusammenspiel in hybriden IT-Landschaften.
  • Du kennst Dich mit Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Management sowie Backup- und Recovery-Konzepten aus und bringst Erfahrung in Infrastrukturmigrationen und Modernisierungsprojekten mit.
  • Du denkst Infrastruktur konsequent unter dem Blickwinkel Security by Design und hast ein gutes Verständnis relevanter Compliance-Anforderungen, z. B. ISO 27001 und NIS2.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, souverän und adressatengerecht und hast Freude daran, Dein Wissen weiterzugeben, Kolleg:innen technisch zu begleiten und gemeinsam Standards weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1) und gutes Englisch (mind. B2)
Wünschenswert
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und idealerweise mit Infrastructure as Code.
  • Du bringst Microsoft-Zertifizierungen oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen mit.
  • Du hast bereits in Hybrid-Cloud-Umgebungen gearbeitet und kennst Monitoring- bzw. Observability-Lösungen.
  • Du verfügst über ein Grundverständnis von Kubernetes und Linux.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in internationalen Unternehmensstrukturen und kannst Dich sicher in komplexen, verteilten IT-Organisationen bewegen.


Deine Benefits – Mehr als nur ein Job!

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph. You'll ship features that solve real customer problems, contribute to our CMS core, extend our platform capabilities, and help bring AI-powered features to life. You won't wait for perfect specs or pixel-perfect designs. jobs.title: Senior Data Modeler (Data Vault)
jobs.description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior Data Modeler, you will play a key role in designing and delivering robust, scalable data models that enable our clients to unlock the full value of their data. You will contribute to critical data initiatives by creating reusable, business-aligned data assets that address complex business challenges. Your work will directly support enterprise data strategies and the implementation of modern, automated data solutions.

You will work closely with client teams to ensure data model consistency, quality, and alignment with enterprise architecture and strategic priorities.

By joining Visium, you will work alongside experts in modern data platforms, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI specialists. Our focus is on enabling customers to make their AI use cases enterprise-ready. Since the quality and preparation of data are crucial for AI success, your role will ultimately empower customers to be ready for an AI-driven future.

As an Expert Data Modeler, this is part of your day-to-day activities:

  • Translate complex business needs into robust models (focus Data Vault 2.0), including conceptual, logical, and physical layers.
  • Design and implement scalable, auditable data products using Data Vault patterns.
  • Ensure modeling consistency and alignment with enterprise standards, especially across multiple data domains and delivery teams.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders and data teams to clarify requirements, define model scope, and align on delivery timelines.
  • Integrate models with modern data platforms with state-of-the-art toolchains (CI/CD, Git)
  • Act as a subject matter expert on modeling approaches, mentoring peers and guiding teams on advanced Data Vault use cases.

Requirements

To apply, this should be part of your background:

  • 4+ years of experience in data modeling, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale data solutions.
  • Experience in data modelling techniques (Dimensional, Data Vault)
  • Understanding of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling and their application in modern data ecosystems.
  • Solid grasp of data governance principles, metadata management, and maintaining business term alignment across models.
  • Experience working in agile environments with a DevOps toolchain (CI/CD, Git, Automation tools)
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional client teams.
  • Fluency in SQL and experience integrating models into data pipelines and BI/reporting layers.
  • Ability to mentor peers and guide modeling decisions, serving as a trusted expert within project teams.
  • Fluent in English.
  • This role involves frequent travelling to Barcelona or any other client site.

Plus:

  • Data Vault 2.0 certification
  • Experience with dbt and Databricks
  • CI/CD practices and pull request workflows for data models.

We know that great candidates might not check every box. If you’re excited about this role and believe you could contribute, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A competitive compensation package
  • A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
  • A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
  • A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
  • A position that enables you to have an impact on 1’000s of people, and the whole company's growth.
  • An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset

Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.

Volle technische Verantwortung für Rocket — direkt an die Gründer, ohne Zwischenebene

tack von Marriott. Unsere Engineers arbeiten also mitten im echten Hotelbetrieb, nicht gegen Sandbox-APIs.

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du Engineering bei MICE DESK — vollständig. Mit dem US-Markteintritt muss Engineering mit Enterprise-Kunden auf zwei Kontinenten Schritt halten.

  • 6 Monate: Delivery ist planbar, die AI-gestützte Dev-Pipeline läuft, und das Team ist um A-Player gewachsen, die du eingestellt hast.
  • 12 Monate: Die Plattform skaliert mit US-Enterprise-Kunden, die Kernsysteme sind zuverlässig und observierbar, und Engineering ist ein Wettbewerbsvorteil — kein Flaschenhals.

Ehrlich gesagt: Das ist volle Verantwortung ohne Netz darüber. Keine CTO-Ebene, die Entscheidungen abnimmt oder abfängt — die Architektur, das Team und alles, was ausgeliefert wird, sind deins.   • Starke Architektur-Expertise: APIs, verteilte Systeme, Event-Driven Design, Cloud.
  • LLM-/agentische AI-Systeme in Produktion — und eine echte Überzeugung, dass Engineering selbst AI-gestützt gehört.

  • Souverän im Umgang mit Ambiguität, Tempo und voller Verantwortung.

Ein Pluspunkt, kein Muss: Hintergrund in Hospitality-Tech, CRM, PMS oder Revenue Management. Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integrationen (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API). Erfahrung in der Führung verteilter, internationaler Teams.


Warum wir?

Und weil wir schnell wachsen, ist vieles bei uns noch im Entstehen. Manche Antwort lautet ehrlicherweise „das bauen wir gerade noch”. Genau darin liegt die Chance: Du triffst auf Freiräume statt auf fertige Strukturen, und was du hier aufbaust, trägt deine Handschrift.

Was wir bieten

  • Arbeit mit echter KI-Technologie auf internationalem Niveau — nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Geschäftsmodell.
  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einem Ideenbriefkasten, sondern in der nächsten Iteration.
  • Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen, nicht in Gremienschleifen.
  • Wachstum, das du mitgehst. Wir bauen gerade die nächste Unternehmensphase — mit Rollen, Verantwortung und Perspektiven, die es vor einem Jahr noch nicht gab.
  • Hauptarbeitsort Leipzig mit regelmäßiger Büropräsenz und flexiblem Homeoffice-Anteil. Hybride Modelle sind bei uns gelebte Praxis, nicht die Ausnahme.
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag, Vollzeit.
  • Leistungsprämien für nachweisbare Erfolge.
  • Mehrtägige Teamevents an Orten, die tatsächlich Spaß machen.
So läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess
  1. Intro-Interview — wir lernen uns kennen, du erfährst, wo wir stehen und wohin wir wollen.
  2. Case Study oder Technical Study, je nach Rolle — ein echtes Problem aus unserem Alltag, das wir gemeinsam durchgehen.
  3. Interview mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft und, je nach Position, mit unseren Gründern.
Vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Entscheidung vergehen bei uns maximal vier Wochen. Und du hörst in jedem Fall von uns — auch dann, wenn es diesmal nicht passt.
